shots.content: Inside a living room, a rectangular coffee table stands between a bookcase and the doorway. A two-seat sofa runs along one long side, facing two armchairs along the opposite side. There is one empty place. A woman in a blue shirt sits in the bookcase-side sofa seat and recounts the dances from the ball. A woman in a purple shirt sits in the bookcase-side armchair. A woman in a red shirt sits in the doorway-side armchair.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the doorway end, looking along the coffee table toward the bookcase, with both sofa seats and both armchairs and the bookcase in frame.

shots.content: A man in a yellow shirt enters and sits in the empty place. He asks the woman in a blue shirt to stop the account of the ball.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the coffee-table side, centered on the two sofa seats.

shots.content: A woman in a blue shirt explains the order of dances from the ball.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the coffee-table side, centered on the person at the bookcase-side sofa seat.

shots.content: A woman in a red shirt asks about the last dance of the ball, and a woman in a blue shirt answers.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the coffee table.
